title: Black Ankle Vineyards

services.name: Our 2028 New Zealand Cruise
services.desc: As promised, we booked another Black Ankle adventure! After soaking up the sun in the Mediterranean last year, we are headed even further afield to the gorgeous shores of New Zealand. We're joining Food & Wine Trails aboard Azamara's elegant ship, Pursuit, sailing from Auckland around the entire New Zealand coast, including the stunning Norfolk Island. Every turn reveals another masterpiece of nature - stunning black-sand beaches, dramatic cliffs, unique wildlife, lush hills and world-class vineyards. Picton and Napier are your gateways to some of the most fertile farmland and colorful vineyards and where you can savor some of New Zealand’s finest wines. Discover Dunedin’s local artistry

blurb: We pride ourselves on making delicious wines that express the unique flavors and atmosphere of the land on which they are grown, from grapes grown only by us on our farms in as sustainable a manner as possible.
